name: main (stage one)
_note: Stage one. Every change goes through a pull request — nobody pushes to main,
including the owner and the workflows.
The status checks are deliberately NOT required yet. A required check that
breaks cannot be fixed, because the fix cannot merge either. Add them once a
few runs of verify and enact have gone green in a row: import
bypass_actors is empty in both stages. The workflows are not privileged; they
pass because records are exempt by path in core/rules.js.
